recipes.name: Classic Comforting Oatmeal
instructions: In a saucepan, combine the oats, milk, cinnamon, pumpkin spice, and one of the bananas*. Cook at a gentle simmer for 5 minutes, stirring often.
Add the other banana and the flaxseeds, cooking for 3 to 5 minute longers. Add more milk for a thinner consistency, or cook for a few more minutes for a thicker porridge.
Remove the saucepan from the heat. Stir in the vanilla, plate, add desired toppings, and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Nutrition tip: aim to use plant-based milk that is fortified with calcium . * The banana will start to partially dissolve as it cooks, which naturally sweetens the oatmeal.
Storage Store the oatmeal, without toppings, in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 2 days.
